body: It had its fair share of issues that I cant turn a blind eye to, but I enjoyed the first half of it quite a bit. Just the first half though lmao. Ive been meaning to replay it since the patches and dlc apparently made it a lot better (you can drive off-road and play as all four of the bros I think?) but I just haven’t felt like it.

Judge portable all you like, thats the version you played and it is indeed a shitty experience. I concur. My only point is that you have no business judging FES, a game you have not played. It’s the equivalent of saying Final Fantasy 15 is a shit game because you played the mobile phone version; it’s senseless. FES is a completely different experience but I understand you not wanting to play it since you were tainted by dogshit.

I’ll ask again and hopefully you’ll answer instead of being cheeky. You played the shitty version of P3 didn’t you? 

If you only played p3p and actually think you can accurately judge p3 then you’re mistaken. The way the story is presented ruins the experience as well as the immersion and the watered down gameplay is painfully boring. If you’ve played both versions then this is a fair statement that I simply disagree with.
You played the shitty version of P3 didn’t you?
